data.one_liner: A Dart implementation of Sass for compiling Sass and SCSS to CSS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a full Sass implementation in Dart that can be used via the command line or as a library to compile stylesheets. It supports parsing and compiling Sass code into standard CSS.
use_when: You need to compile Sass or SCSS stylesheets within a Dart environment.
You prefer a native Dart implementation of the Sass preprocessor.
avoid_when: You are looking for UI widget kits or runtime theme switching components for Flutter.
You do not use Sass/SCSS in your styling workflow.
strengths: High performance and portable Dart implementation.
Can be used as a command-line tool, a Dart library, or through JavaScript/npm.
weaknesses: Not a runtime Flutter styling engine; it is a preprocessor for stylesheets.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and import 'package:sass/sass.dart' as sass.
